title: Cap of two casino licences (New South Wales)
summary: The Casino Control Act 1992 (NSW) allows no more than two casino licences to be in force at a time.
direction_rationale: A legislated cap on the number of casino licences.

verified.notes: An existing setting: no dates. Quoted from the corpus copy of the Act (August 2024).

assessment.summary: No more than two casino licences may be in force in New South Wales. A legislated cap on numbers that shields the licensees from new entrants.

marks.reason: A cap of two on casino licences: no other casino can enter.
Two licensees face no new rivals in their market.

assessment.confidence_note: The cap is explicit in the Act.
